text:
Priya: heads up — ACME wants a multi-region egress add-on that meters per-region usage and can be toggled per-route. They want soft-start pricing for first 3 months and then normal rates.
Ava: do they mean per-request routing + separate metering buckets?
Priya: yes. per-route tagging in requests -> bill by destination region. also needs per-customer cap and alerting.
Jai: finance note — soft-start means we need prorated invoicing and a flag in billing to apply promotional rates for N days. is that in scope for launch?
Marco: tagging wise we can add a route_metadata header and map to region. backend can surface region_id to billing. effort estimate ~3w infra + 1w console.
Sam: commercial ask — customer wants this live for pilot on June 1. they will sign a 12mo commit if we support the soft-start ramp.
Ava: engineering constraints: Dedicated pools vs Hosted — dedicated customers might already pin regions. need fallback rules if region not available.
Priya: launch criteria proposal: 1) per-route tag accepted by API and Console 2) billing metric exposed as "egress.region.*" 3) promo window config (days + rate) 4) migration path for existing customers 5) docs + eval tests.
Jai: add legal: prorating rules and service-level wording. cc @ops-bot for audit trace requirement.
ops-bot: note recorded — will require audit logging for per-route tag creation and grant change history.
Marco: quick config sketch:
```
POST /v1/requests
headers: {"X-Route-Region": "eu-west-1", "X-Route-Tag": "payments"}
body: {"model":"redwood-4x","input":"..."}
```
Billing would pick up X-Route-Region -> map to egress metric.
Ava: QA question — do we allow multiple regions per request? e.g., fan-out? that complicates billing.
Priya: prod ask: support single region per request for launch, fan-out rollback to unified egress bucket.
Sam: negotiation point — customer insists on soft-start pricing for whole org, not just routes. can we offer org-level promo that overlays region metering?
Jai: yes but requires billing to support overlay discounts. extra work. likely add-on to V2.
Priya: decision-needed: greenlight scoped launch with single-region-per-request + org-level promo as manual override (sales/finance assisted) or delay to build overlay discount. thoughts?
Ava: prefer scoped launch. reduces cross-team work and still lets sales close pilot.
Marco: agree — scoped launch now, overlay discount in next milestone.
Sam: I'll push for a clause in contract: we implement org promo within 90 days or credit back if not met. sales ok with that.
Jai: finance okay with pilot credits; legal to draft SLA/credit wording.
Priya: action items: Priya -> finalize launch criteria doc, Marco -> infra task list + estimate, Ava -> API + SDK changes, Jai -> billing schema + promo toggle, Sam -> get contract language draft from legal.
Ava: will prepare a short changelog for Console UX.
Priya: thanks team. tagging for weekly roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
